headline: Flotek Industries Reports Q3 Revenue Above $100 Million and Raises Guidance
summary: Flotek Industries announced third-quarter 2026 revenue of $114.4 million, reaching a twelve-year high, and increased its financial guidance.
why: Flotek Industries is a technology-driven chemistry and data solutions company serving the energy and industrial sectors.

impacts.name: Flotek Industries, Inc.
impacts.why: Better-than-expected quarterly revenue and raised guidance typically drive positive investor sentiment and share price appreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong financial results and upwardly revised guidance signal robust operational performance, prompting positive market revaluation.
